mostWorthwhile.text: Placing the traction panels was most worthwhile: the explanation of the rails spreading wheel loads made the solution understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the framed panels felt least substantial because the result gave no further detail.

surprise.text: The initial winch result said the crossing remained supported beneath the wheels before the panels were built, which was confusing.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt purposeless, although the wording after anchoring the winch briefly made the sequence unclear.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical crossing was satisfying, and I am curious about the exposed ice beyond it, although the mostly forced choices offered little decision-making.
